segments.name: Retail Business
segments.description: Operates retail outlets and digital platform sales in Singapore and Korea, selling furniture to individual consumers, including franchisee and department store channels.
segments.evidence: The Retail segment of the Company includes the results of operations of HTL SG and HTLK.

segments.name: Export Sales Business
segments.description: Sells upholstered sofas and other products to business customers overseas through export entities across Europe, Australia, North America and Asia Pacific.
segments.evidence: The Export Sales segment of the Company includes the results of operations of HTL FE, HTLF, HTLA, HTLJ, HTLUK, and HTL Marketing in relation to export sales.

segments.name: Leather Trading
segments.description: Trades leather materials to corporate customers, primarily through HTL Marketing, with sales focused on leather materials.
segments.evidence: The Leather Trading segment of the Company includes the results of operations of HTL Marketing in relation to leather trading.

revenueModel.text: Individual consumers pay retail outlets in Singapore and Korea for furniture, while business and corporate customers pay for exported upholstered sofas and leather materials.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's export sales revenue and leather trading revenue are principally derived from the sale of products, including upholstered sofas, and sale of leather materials, to corporate customers in overseas.
